prefix_utility.api: verify_cover(n, prefixes, projected_bits=None, aux_bound=None) -> {covered: bool, uncovered: int|null, trie_nodes: int, arithmetic_verified: false}
prefix_utility.semantics: A pair (depth,prefix) covers all n-bit assignments whose lowest depth bits equal prefix. Variable 0 is first, LSB-first. n>=0, 0<=depth<=n, 0<=prefix<2^depth; canonical Python integers only, never bool. Defaults projected_bits=n; require 0<=projected_bits<=n. aux_bound=None means the entire Boolean cube; otherwise integer 0<=aux_bound<=2^(n-projected_bits) restricts auxiliary integer bits>>projected_bits <aux_bound.
prefix_utility.algorithm: Iterative sparse binary trie, no recursion depending on n and no 2^n enumeration. Insert prefixes; terminal nodes cover their complete subtree. At depth d the minimum auxiliary value is prefix>>projected_bits. If it is at least aux_bound, prune the entire invalid subtree. A missing valid child yields the concrete zero-filled n-bit integer witness immediately. Otherwise visit represented nodes only.
postconditions: covered=true iff supplied prefix cylinders cover every assignment in the stated Boolean/auxiliary domain.
covered=false returns an in-domain assignment matched by no supplied prefix.
Repeated/overlapping prefixes are accepted idempotently. Empty prefix covers the full domain; bound zero denotes empty domain.
trie_nodes<=1+sum(depth); construction/traversal O(sum(depth)+1) trie operations apart from integer-bit/input/output costs. This is a symbolic implementation bound, not a benchmark.

arithmetic_verified=false always: prefixes are NOT checked algebraic clauses or validated models. No UNSAT, SAT, ECDLP or transcript validity follows from utility coverage alone. No adapter is admitted.
prefix_utility.independent_check: Independently test witnesses against all supplied prefixes/domain. Tiny brute-force oracle allowed only for these fixed n<=4 cases; never enumerate the n=256 fixtures. No general sweep.

execution.runner_contract: Each new test script implements --receipt PATH, hashes its own source and all imported target sources before execution, runs its own named unittest suite and the exact old18 regression command once, and records actual command/stdout/stderr/returncode plus every named assertion outcome. No hard-coded passing receipt. Both commands remain ordinary software tests; no solver/search/SAT invocation.
execution.attempts: Retain every attempt with exact source SHA and diagnostics. Up to four software suite invocations per actor (normally one new suite and one old regression); extra attempts may only fix the new harness itself, without changing fixed fixtures or frozen targets. Stop on a target-source defect and preserve it; do not repair old code or silently relax expected assertions.
receipt_fields: mutant guard transformations and isolated findings
execution.measurements: Wall timestamps are custody only; unittest elapsed text is preserved without speed interpretation. No success-rate, scaling or timing comparison.

independence: Reviewer receives this fixed specification and frozen old implementation, authors a separate test suite without reading producer new tests/results/README, and may read/import snapshot-bound prefix_cover.py. This is independent assertion/execution testing and source audit, not a new blind theorem review.
closure: No H/EV/KN creation, no old-status rewriting, no goal promotion. Finite software checks do not prove all-prime correctness.
